articles.summary: March marks Amyloidosis Awareness Month. We sat down with Charles, an 88-year-old retired cardiologist from Massachusetts, who shared what it’s like to diagnose and treat heart disease for decades and then face a diagnosis himself. His experience with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) offers a unique perspective on this underrecognized condition.
articles.title: From Treating ATTR-CM to Living with It: A Cardiologist's Story | Amyloidosis Awareness Month | IONIS
